## Why

Before this row every connector claim subject minted `entity_type='deployment'`: agencies, contracts, portals, bills and meetings are keyed, served and joined as deployments (`/v1/entity/deployment/<id>` returns an Austin PD organization; `inference/accountability.py`'s deployment-typed anchor joins wrongly). The spine is append-only, so the correction is a new decision layer — never `UPDATE`s of the mistyped rows.

## What ships

- **The committed, versioned map** — `db/src/db/data/subject_entity_types.toml` (`version = "1.0.0"`): every connector subject family prefix → its `vocab_entity_type` member (`agency:`/`agency_registry_entry:`/`audit_org:`/`data_driven:agency:` → `organization`, `contract:`/`procurement_notice:` → `contract`, `flock_portal:`/`sig:dataset:`/`seed:` → `data_system`, `osm:`/`traffic_camera:` → `physical_asset`, `atlas:`/`sig:deployment:`/`audit_deployment:`/`pathways:` → `deployment`, `legal_instrument:`/`legislative_bill:`/`agenda_item:`/`sig:document:` → `legal_instrument`, `jurisdiction:` → `jurisdiction`, `records:`/`madada:` → `records_request`, `accountability:`/`legal_proceeding:`/`funding_instrument:`/`usage_aggregate:`/`ccops:` → their §11 types). `db/subject_types.py` loads it via `importlib.resources`, validates every declared type against `vocab_entity_type`, resolves **longest-prefix first**, and raises `UnmappedSubjectScheme` for anything unmapped. Non-claim record kinds (`agenda_document`, `portal_document`, `registry_query_meta`, `*_artifact`, `tenant_api_error`) are deliberately unmapped — if one reaches the mint path it refuses rather than guesses.
- **Mint-path change** (`db/src/db/claim_sink.py`): `PgClaimSink` resolves each subject through the map (`subject_typer` injectable so synthetic plumbing fixtures keep working); an unmapped subject quarantines `unknown_subject_scheme` (new `QuarantineReason`) **before** run/evidence/entity minting. A subject-scheme `object_ref` must declare the type the map declares — a disagreement quarantines too. `ops.seed` resolves seeded subjects through the same map + `resolve_identity_batch`; `flock_portal` portal-partner object refs mint the mapped `data_system` so a portal slug mints identically as subject and object.
- **The append-only typed-identity write** (`db/src/db/typed_identity.py`, `sig-db typed-identity`): `plan_decisions` reads `entity_identity_key`, reports per-type pending corrections and unmapped subjects (reported, never typed); `apply_decisions` `INSERT`s `entity_type_decision` rows `ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING` — **+0 on rerun**; existing `entity`/`entity_identity_key` rows are never `UPDATE`d/`DELETE`d. Dry-run by default; `--apply` is the only write path. `entity_current_type` resolves the latest decision over the recorded column.
- **The recorded anchor re-point** (`inference/src/inference/accountability.py` — the consumer the ticket names at `:401`): the accountability-link anchor now resolves each entity's CURRENT type through `entity_current_type` once the L1 decisions land (`to_regclass` probe — a pre-L1 spine reads the recorded column unchanged). Anchors are `deployment` + `physical_asset` entities (a registry camera IS the deployed thing) plus `sig.connector.subject`-keyed `organization`s — a subject-minted agency anchors its own `vendor`/`oversight` claims exactly as it did when every subject minted `deployment`; an org minted as a claim OBJECT stays a non-anchor (procured ≠ deployed). The `operator`/`vendor` legs accept the accountable-anchor type set; the placeholder domain map still excludes procurement/event record subjects.
- **Sqitch `entity_typing_mobility_check`** (`[closed_vocabulary domain_entities entity_identity_key]`, plan tail — L44–52 untouched): `entity_type_decision` (UNIQUE idempotency barrier, FK to `entity_identity_key`, immutability trigger, `entity_current_type` view, `spine_watermark` facet, least-privilege grants) + `physical_asset_mobility_vocab` `CHECK (mobility IN …)` **NOT VALID** (Mobility enum: `fixed|redeployable|vehicle_mounted|airborne|handheld|unknown` — binds new writes; a `VALIDATE` follow-up is deliberately out of scope) + `assertion_quarantine` reason CHECK widened with `unknown_subject_scheme`. `SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '5s'` bounds the `ACCESS EXCLUSIVE` wait.
